profile_text.body:
Humane Intelligence is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2022 and based in Katy, Texas. The organization describes itself as dedicated to breaking down barriers to AI deployment for social good, stating that it collaboratively designs and runs rigorous evaluations that make AI systems more accountable, responsible, and fair.

The company offers three main services. Red teaming is a paid service using the organization's own software, which it plans to release under an open source software license in 2026. AI Contextual Evaluations are bespoke, mixed-method evaluations designed to assess an AI model or system's performance for specified problem spaces, with the organization rapidly developing knowledge graph and ontological AI problem space mapping capabilities in 2026. Bias bounties are collaboratively designed challenge sets that bring together researchers, impacted communities, and domain experts to examine and improve AI and machine learning systems, models, and datasets. The organization's final self-hosted bias bounty closed in November 2025, and it is working to move its bias bounty program onto Zindi, a global data science challenge platform, in 2026.
